params.candidateBondRequirement_: The minimum active stake required to stand as a bonded candidate.
params.cycleDuration_: The total recurring duration between consecutive election end timestamps.
params.maxCandidateCount_: The maximum number of active candidates permitted in a cycle.
params.maxScheduleLeadTime_: The maximum permitted lead time between scheduling and voting start.
params.minimumNominationDuration_: The minimum nomination duration enforced for a cycle.
params.minimumVotingDuration_: The minimum voting duration enforced for a cycle.
params.runnerUpCount_: The number of runner-up slots retained for vacancy filling.
params.seatCount_: The number of Congress seats awarded per cycle.

returns.duration: The duration between consecutive election end timestamps.

returns.amount: The maximum absolute negative allocation permitted.

returns.count: The maximum number of positive ballot targets.

candidateBondRequirement().notice: Returns the minimum active stake required to stand as a bonded Congress candidate.

candidateEligibilityPolicy().notice: Returns the configured candidate eligibility policy address.

cycleDuration().notice: Returns the total recurring election cycle duration.

isEligibleCandidate(address).notice: Returns true when a wallet may stand as a candidate.

isEligibleVoter(address).notice: Returns true when a wallet may cast a weighted Congress ballot.

maxCandidateCount().notice: Returns the maximum number of active candidates permitted in one cycle.

maxNegativeAllocation(address).notice: Returns the maximum negative allocation allowed for a ballot weight.

maxPositiveCandidates().notice: Returns the maximum number of positively allocated candidates permitted in a ballot.

maxScheduleLeadTime().notice: Returns the maximum lead time permitted between scheduling and voting start.

minimumNominationDuration().notice: Returns the minimum nomination duration enforced for each election cycle.

minimumVotingDuration().notice: Returns the minimum voting duration enforced for each election cycle.

runnerUpCount().notice: Returns the number of runner-up slots to retain each cycle.

seatCount().notice: Returns the number of Congress seats to award each cycle.

votingPowerPolicy().notice: Returns the configured voting power policy address.

votingWeight(address).notice: Returns the weighted Congress ballot power for a wallet.
